welcome.title: Welcome to your local construction workspace
welcome.subtitle: Before you begin, here is how OpenConKit protects source workbooks and keeps you in control.
welcome.localHelp: Copied workbook revisions, analyses, and reports are stored under the OpenConKit application data folder.
welcome.sourceHelp: OpenConKit reads the workbook you select and analyzes an immutable managed copy. Reports are always created as new files.
welcome.aiHelp: Deterministic BOQ analysis works offline. AI features remain off until you enable them and consent before sending selected facts.
welcome.noTelemetry: No analytics, crash-reporting beacons, or background data collection.

home.title: Home
home.subtitle: Review workbooks and reopen trusted results from one local workspace.

workbooks.copyUnchanged: The workbook will be copied into OpenConKit and kept unchanged.
workbooks.desktopImportOnly: Workbook import uses the installed desktop app.

start.subtitle: Run deterministic quality checks against an immutable workbook revision.
start.chooseSourceHelp: Select the exact workbook revision that should be reviewed, or import a new workbook.
start.readOnlyHelp: Analysis reads OpenConKit’s local copy and writes findings and reports as new records.

assurance.local: Core analysis works entirely on this device.
assurance.unchanged: The source workbook is never modified in place.
assurance.deterministic: Findings cite the rule, sheet, cell, and source evidence.

progress.title: Analysis progress
progress.keepOpen: You can cancel safely; completed work is never applied to the workbook.

results.noRunHelp: Choose a completed run from History, or analyze a workbook revision.
results.paretoAria: Share of priced items needed to reach at least eighty percent of value
results.paretoStatement: of {{total}} priced items reach {{share}}% of value
results.noPareto: Commercial concentration was not calculated because comparable positive amounts were unavailable.
results.deterministicFooter: Deterministic analysis · No AI used for these findings

ai.label: AI-generated commentary
ai.title: Grounded AI review
ai.help: Optional commentary on the normalized rows and deterministic findings shown above. It cannot change findings or the workbook.
ai.empty: No AI commentary has been generated for this analysis.
ai.consentHelp: OpenConKit will send the selected normalized workbook facts and deterministic findings to your ChatGPT/Codex service.
ai.consentStatement: The source workbook path and file are not shared. Only the exact extracted scope summarized here is transmitted. Large scopes use deterministic source chunks followed by a grounded synthesis.
ai.offlineReminder: You may cancel. Core analysis and reports continue to work offline without AI.
ai.footer: AI commentary remains separate from deterministic findings

exports.desktopOnly: Report export uses the installed desktop app.

history.title: Analysis history
history.subtitle: Reopen persisted results with their exact source, rule set, and application versions.
history.emptyHelp: Completed, failed, and cancelled analyses will appear here.

boqInspector.name: BOQ Inspector
boqInspector.description: Automated Bill of Quantities quality review.

lowConfidenceStructure.title: Workbook structure needs review
lowConfidenceStructure.explanation: The detected table structure has {{confidence}}% confidence.
lowConfidenceStructure.action: Review the detected table and column mappings before relying on downstream findings.

unmappedColumn.title: Column {{column}} could not be mapped
unmappedColumn.explanation: The column did not consistently match a supported BOQ role.
unmappedColumn.action: Confirm what the column represents or exclude it from the BOQ table.

missingColumn.title: No {{field}} column was detected
missingColumn.explanation: The detected BOQ table does not contain a confidently mapped {{field}} column.
missingColumn.action: Review the table mapping and identify the intended {{field}} column.

missingValue.title: Missing {{field}}
missingValue.explanation: This priced item has no usable {{field}} value.
missingValue.action: Enter or verify the {{field}} value in the source workbook.

zeroValue.title: Zero {{field}}
zeroValue.explanation: This priced item contains a zero {{field}} value.

negativeValue.title: Negative {{field}}
negativeValue.explanation: This priced item contains a negative {{field}} value.
negativeValue.action: Confirm that the negative value represents an intended credit or adjustment.

spreadsheetError.title: Spreadsheet error: {{error}}
spreadsheetError.explanation: The cell contains an Excel error or a formula without a cached result.
spreadsheetError.action: Repair the formula in the source workbook and recalculate it in Excel.

brokenFormula.title: Formula has no usable result
brokenFormula.explanation: The formula result is missing or is an Excel error.
brokenFormula.action: Repair and recalculate the formula in the source workbook.

formulaResultMismatch.title: Cached formula result is inconsistent
formulaResultMismatch.explanation: The supported formula evaluates to {{expected}}, but its cached result is {{actual}}.
formulaResultMismatch.action: Open the source workbook in Excel, verify the formula, and recalculate it.

formulaUnverifiable.title: Formula could not be verified
formulaUnverifiable.explanation: This formula is outside the safe supported subset. Its cached result was not judged correct or incorrect.
formulaUnverifiable.action: Review this formula manually in the source workbook.

amountMismatch.title: Amount does not match quantity × rate
amountMismatch.action: Verify the quantity, rate, amount, and formula.

exactDuplicate.title: Possible duplicate item
exactDuplicate.explanation: An item with the same normalized description, unit, quantity, rate, and amount appears earlier.
exactDuplicate.action: Confirm whether both rows are required.

crossSheetDuplicate.title: Duplicate item across sheets
crossSheetDuplicate.explanation: The same priced item also appears on sheet {{sheet}}.
crossSheetDuplicate.action: Confirm that the item is not counted twice.

crossSheetInconsistency.title: Item differs across sheets
crossSheetInconsistency.explanation: The same description appears on sheet {{sheet}} with different pricing or unit data.
crossSheetInconsistency.action: Reconcile the unit, quantity, rate, and amount between sheets.

fuzzyDuplicate.title: Similar item descriptions
fuzzyDuplicate.explanation: These descriptions are {{similarity}}% similar and may represent the same work.
fuzzyDuplicate.action: Compare the two rows and consolidate them if they duplicate scope.

inconsistentUnit.title: Similar items use different units
inconsistentUnit.explanation: Descriptions are {{similarity}}% similar, but the normalized units differ.
inconsistentUnit.action: Confirm the intended units; no unit conversion has been applied.

subtotalMismatch.title: Subtotal does not match preceding items
subtotalMismatch.action: Review the subtotal formula and its included rows.

totalMismatch.title: Total does not match priced items
totalMismatch.action: Review the total formula and the item rows included in it.

valueOutlier.title: {{field}} differs sharply from comparable items
valueOutlier.explanation: Value {{value}} is far from the peer median {{median}} across {{peerCount}} comparable items.
valueOutlier.action: Confirm the value and the item's unit, currency, and table context.

paretoSummary.title: {{topItemCount}} of {{totalItemCount}} items reach at least 80% of value
paretoSummary.action: Prioritize review of the highest-value items shown in this group.

limitationsText.readOnly: The source workbook was analyzed read-only; this report is a separate new file.
limitationsText.formulaSubset: Formula verification covers only the documented safe arithmetic subset. Unsupported formulas are identified for manual review, not judged.
limitationsText.confidence: Low-confidence structure interpretations and review candidates require professional confirmation.

diagnostics.headerlessDistributionInference: Headerless structure inferred from value distributions
diagnostics.noTablesDetected: No reliable BOQ table was detected
diagnostics.rowColumnVisibilityUnavailable: Legacy workbook row/column visibility metadata is unavailable

settings.title: Settings
settings.subtitle: Control language, appearance, deterministic analysis, privacy, and updates.
settings.appearanceHelp: Follow Windows automatically or choose a fixed language and theme.
settings.analysisHelp: These exact values control deterministic comparisons. They do not change source workbooks.
settings.privacyHelp: OpenConKit has no telemetry. Optional features remain off until you explicitly enable them.
settings.aiFeaturesHelp: Optional and separate from deterministic findings. A consent step appears before any workbook facts are sent.
settings.diagnosticLoggingHelp: After restart, store size-rotated protocol metadata locally under app home. Workbook values, prompts, responses, credentials, and stderr text are excluded.
settings.updatesHelp: Choose which signed OpenConKit releases the updater may offer.
settings.notChecked: No successful update check has been recorded.
settings.saveChannelBeforeCheck: Save the new channel before checking for updates.
settings.updatesDesktopOnly: Update checks are available in the installed desktop app.
settings.portableUpdateHelp: This portable copy cannot replace itself safely. Download the new portable package from the official release page.
settings.advancedHelp: Development and troubleshooting controls. The bundled, verified runtime is recommended.
settings.systemCodexHelp: Use an explicitly selected compatible Codex executable instead of the bundled runtime.
settings.systemCodexRestart: Restart OpenConKit after saving. The executable must report the exact pinned Codex version.
settings.resetHelp: Erase OpenConKit-managed local data and return the app to its first-run state.
settings.resetSummary: Delete managed workbook copies, analyses, reports, settings, logs, and caches.
settings.resetWarning: This permanently deletes all data stored inside the OpenConKit app home, then restarts the app at onboarding.
settings.resetKeepsOriginals: Original workbooks outside OpenConKit and account credentials managed outside the app are not changed.
settings.aiDisabled: AI-assisted review is off. Deterministic analysis and reports remain fully available.
settings.aiDesktopOnly: Account controls are available in the installed desktop app.
settings.aiAccountHelp: Codex manages sign-in securely. OpenConKit never reads or stores your tokens.
settings.aiRuntimeMissing: The selected Codex runtime is unavailable.
settings.aiBundledRuntime: Using the bundled, verified Codex runtime.
settings.aiSystemRuntime: Using the selected system Codex runtime.
settings.aiSignedOut: Sign in to use optional AI commentary.
settings.aiUsage: {{percent}}% of the current primary limit used
settings.aiLimitReached: The current account limit has been reached.
settings.aiCompleteLogin: Complete sign-in in the browser, then refresh the account status.

about.localFirstHelp: Workbooks, findings, and reports remain under your OpenConKit app home. There is no telemetry.
about.readOnlyHelp: Imported workbooks are immutable revisions. Reports are always created as new files.
about.licenseHelp: OpenConKit is licensed under Apache-2.0. Third-party notices ship with every distribution.
about.copyright: OpenConKit is an independent open-source project for construction professionals.
